blurb: Colorado Watersports provides equipment rentals and camps introducing kids to sailing and paddlecraft basics. Camps take place in a safe, controlled 'No Wake Zone' at Chatfield Lake with experienced instructors. Campers learn to steer and manage vessels themselves, fostering self-reliance and teamwork.
